One Piece.label: Sea Circle calendar
One Piece.note: Anchored to the February 18 Reverse Mountain reconstruction. The installed event spacing is approximate, not a complete canon day-by-day chronology.

sources.title: The Library of Ohara — sourced timeline reconstruction

Hunter x Hunter.label: Hunter world calendar
Hunter x Hunter.note: The 287th Hunter Exam anchors January 7, 1999. Other dates follow the installed approximate event spacing.

Jujutsu Kaisen.label: Gregorian calendar
Jujutsu Kaisen.note: Shibuya is anchored to October 31, 2018. Other dates retain the installed approximate event spacing; they are campaign projections, not newly verified canon dates.

Bleach.label: World of the Living calendar
Bleach.note: Mid-May 2001 is the reconstructed opening window. May 18 is a campaign anchor, not a confirmed exact day. Realm travel does not silently reset this shared clock.

Naruto.label: Shinobi calendar
Naruto.note: October 10 anchors Naruto’s birth. The numbered Birth era is a game convention because a canonical civil year is not established here. Other dates follow the installed chronology.

Overgeared.label: Satisfy calendar
Overgeared.note: A fixed Satisfy launch epoch, not an asserted canon month or Earth year. Dates track in-world time; they are not multiplied again by the real-world login ratio.

Reincarnated as a Slime.label: Central World calendar
Reincarnated as a Slime.note: A fixed civil calendar relative to Rimuru’s arrival. The month/day and era numbering are game conventions where the installed sources provide only relative dates.

Solo Max-Level Newbie.label: Tower-era calendar
Solo Max-Level Newbie.note: A fixed Tower-arrival calendar; no unverified Earth year is asserted. Existing saves with an explicit Earth-date epoch retain that epoch.

Custom World.label: World calendar
Custom World.note: Default configurable-world civil calendar. Explicit saved epochs are preserved. The default epoch is a game convention, not canon.
